title: "It opens on your watch too" is said even when the member turned that off
what: After tapping Install on watch with the watch app already there, the app says "When you start a workout, it opens on your watch too." It says this to every member, also one who switched off "Open MettleUp on my watch" in Settings. For that member nothing opens on the watch at a workout start.
expected: The line only promises the watch opening when that setting is on; otherwise it says the watch app is ready and how to open it.
who: members who turned off the watch opening
how_often: every time they tap Install on watch with the app already there
fix_line: Pick the line by the setting: with it off, drop the "opens on your watch" half.

title: "Your phone and watch buzz when rest is over" is shown to members with no watch
what: The Rest alerts row says "On time - Your phone and watch buzz when rest is over" whenever Android lets the alert through. The check looks only at the phone's notification and alarm switches; it never asks whether a watch with MettleUp is connected. A member with no watch is told their watch buzzes.
expected: The watch is named only when a watch with the app is connected; otherwise the line talks about the phone alone.
how_often: every visit to Rest timer and sounds
fix_line: Say "Your phone buzzes" and add "and your watch" only when the watch app is found.

title: "Nothing was saved" can be cut off in the note after Done from the lock screen
what: When Done on the rest card cannot log the set with the app closed, the phone posts a note such as "Open MettleUp to log Incline Dumbbell Bench Press" / "That rest card was out of date, so nothing was saved." The note has a single line of text and no way to expand it, so on a 320-390 px wide phone the end of the line, the part that says nothing was saved, is cut off with dots. Long exercise names cut the title too.
expected: The note can be expanded to show its full text, or the short words come first ("Not saved: add the weight").
who: members who tap Done on the lock screen or watch
how_often: whenever Done cannot log a set
fix_line: Give the note an expanding text style and put "Not saved" first.

title: The pause buttons use Title Case while every other button uses sentence case
what: In a live workout the timer menu offers "Pause Workout Timer" and "Resume Workout Timer", copied from Hevy, while the sheet title right above says "Workout timer" and other buttons are in sentence case ("Resume workout", "Discard and start new").
expected: One style: "Pause workout timer" / "Resume workout timer".
who: every member who pauses a workout
how_often: every time the timer menu opens
fix_line: Change the two labels to sentence case (the phone test that reads them changes too).
